business_problem: The China Cultural Relics Exchange Center and partner museums wanted a scalable way to provide narration, consultation, live streaming and cultural promotion without being limited by the time, place and staffing constraints of human guides.
solution_summary: The China Cultural Relics Exchange Center used Baidu AI Cloud's Xiling digital-human stack to launch Wenyaoyao, a virtual museum promoter designed for public explanation, live streaming and cultural outreach. The implementation is built on a platform that connects portrait driving, dialogue, voice and recommendation engines with persona management, content production and business orchestration. That allowed the team to build a culturally themed avatar that could discuss artifacts, interpret reports, guide audiences through exhibitions and serve multiple museums at the same time through digital clones. The same platform also gives operators a way to enrich the knowledge base behind the character so it can answer historical, artistic and scientific questions without traditional training cycles. Rather than treating Wenyaoyao as a standalone mascot, the project turned Baidu's digital-human platform into a reusable infrastructure layer for museum explanation, volunteer services, international promotion and future digital-IP operations.

solution_components.name: Xiling Intelligent Digital Human Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the end-to-end production and operation platform for museum digital humans.

solution_components.name: Digital Human Livestream Platform
solution_components.role: Lets Wenyaoyao deliver live explanations, hosting and cultural-promotion sessions.

solution_components.name: Portrait Driving Engine
solution_components.role: Animates Wenyaoyao's appearance and movement for human-like presentation.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Dialogue Engine
solution_components.role: Supports question answering and conversational guidance across museum scenarios.

solution_components.name: Intelligent Recommendation Engine
solution_components.role: Helps personalize content and service presentation within the digital-human platform.

data_flow: Museum content, artifact knowledge and event scripts are loaded into the digital-human platform, where portrait and dialogue engines render Wenyaoyao's appearance and answers and then distribute the resulting explanations and livestream sessions across museums and promotional channels.
business_outcome: The center launched a reusable virtual guide and promoter that can serve multiple museums, increase accessibility to cultural content and extend museum outreach into digital and overseas settings.
metrics: 2D digital-human production can be reduced to minutes, while 3D photorealistic production can be compressed to one to two weeks.
architecture_clues: The platform distinguishes between service-type and performance-type digital humans
Persona management, business orchestration and content production are on the same platform
Digital clones can serve dozens or hundreds of museums at the same time
